blocks.text: Guildford homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Guildford, October 2026. Detached houses: 41 listed at month end and 6 sold in October, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 164 listed at month end and 16 sold in October, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 21 sold over 5 months against an average of 40.4 listed, about 9.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 6 sold. Condos and townhomes: 82 sold over 5 months against an average of 157.6 listed, about 9.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 23 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Guildford?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 41 houses listed with 6 sold in the month and 164 condos and townhomes listed with 16 sold in the month in Guildford. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Guildford a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 15%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 10%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
